title: Change a function signature and update every caller
prompt: Refactor `createUser` in src/users.js from positional arguments `createUser(name, email, isAdmin)` to a single options object `createUser({ name, email, role })`, where `role` is "admin" or "member" (default "member"). The returned user object must now have a `role` field instead of `isAdmin`. Calling createUser with anything other than a plain object must throw a TypeError, and an unknown role must throw a RangeError. Update every caller in src/ so the app behaves the same, and update the tests in test/ to the new shape.
